It has the quote word for word, including the bracketed "[general artificial intelligence]". The next line on the page is: "So anything beyond that sort of time horizon means it is very difficult for me to say the difference between 20 years and 50 years. So I think it is definitely a long way off…" The text I got back had no date for the article or the talk.
